title: Critical Cisco Expressway Flaw Lets Attackers Execute Commands as Root
content_md: Cisco has released security updates to address a critical vulnerability in its Expressway Series. This flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-76466, could allow unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands with root privileges. It has a CVSS v3.1 base score of 9.8 and affects vulnerable Expressway deployments configured in a cluster.
